use_case_name: Publish Air and Surface Surveillance Tracks

claims.content: To enable C2 JUs to report and share real-time air and surface (maritime) track data, including positional information, velocity, and identity, with other network participants for situational awareness and common tracking.

goal.raw_text: To enable C2 JUs to report and share real-time air and surface (maritime) track data, including positional information, velocity, and identity, with other network participants for situational awareness and common tracking.

claims.content: The C2 JU must have the capability to originate and report real-time air, surface (maritime), land (ground), or space tracks.
The C2 JU must have an automatic correlation capability for comparing locally derived sensor data with received interface data.
If the C2 JU is reporting air or surface tracks, it shall have the capability to transmit and receive all response values of the J7.2 message for real-time tracks held locally.
The C2 JU originates real-time air or surface tracks based on locally derived sensor data (position, velocity, and altitude) to provide threat warning information and situational awareness.
